Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1303
Claimant:
Jacqueline Moody
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
19 Nov 2024
Claim received today for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second vehicle. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
28 Nov 2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force on the date of loss. No issues with
the policy itself were found at intake.
22 Jan 2025
Otbained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Officers' observations
of the scene line up with the parties' descriptions.
2 Mar 2025
Reviewed scene photos and spoke with two independent witnesses, both of whom describe the accident the same
way the claimant and the other driver did. Their accounts are consistent on the sequence of events.
10 Mar 2025
Inspected the vehicle. The damage is mostly on the driver's side and is in line with the described impact. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or repair records.
18 Mar 2025
Claimant reported a concussion. The injury fits the kind and force of a side impact of this type, and the medical file
reflects a usual course of care that tapered as the patient improved.
25 Mar 2025
Medical history shows a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no ongoing
complaints. Noted for completeness and reviewed with the treating records.
13 Apr 2025
Claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far, including the iintial report, the recorded statement,
and the follow-up call with counsel present.
18 Apr 2025
Counsel has requested a copy of the claim file and the repair estimate. Sent both through the approved channel and
confirmed receipt.
26 Apr 2025
Nothing so far suggests the damage predates the coverage period. Claim remains open pending final medical review
and the repair invoice.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
